_why: Voice on the free local route (Chatterbox, MIT weights, voice/LICENSING.md). Owner verdict on food sample round 1, 2026-10-13: ONE VOICE, NORMAL EXPLAINER PACE, START TO FINISH - the calm register and its title-card switch are removed; the imagery carries the hypnotic quality, not the narration. Guarded by validator V54 (loop/validate.py) and loop/tests/test_food_voice_sound.py, which measure the rendered audio per beat, not this file.

standard.note: the channel's existing read (voice/narrate_all.py defaults), used for every beat

contract._rule: no beat's median pitch may sit more than 1 semitone from the video's median, no beat's speech rate more than 20% from the median, and no third of the video may pace (words over total seconds, pauses included) more than 20% from the others - a mid-video change of pace or pitch FAILS
contract._calibration: Measured 2026-10-13. One unchanged voice (round 2 sample, 8 beats, same settings) varies naturally: speech 148-191 wpm (median 163, +17%/-9%), pitch within 0.6 semitone, thirds 177/157/151 wpm. Round 1's register change measured -2.0 semitones and thirds 161/128/112 (-20%/-30% from the opening). The limits sit between the two: 1 semitone, 20% per beat, 20% per third.
